strategies.name: Overnight Range Breakout and Retest Strategy
strategies.entry_summary: Identify the overnight high and low (pre-market range). Wait for price to break above the high or below the low with strength/weakness. After the break, wait for price to pull back and retest the breakout level, confirming the trend with bullish/bearish price action.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop loss is placed on the opposite side of the breakout level (below the high for longs, above the low for shorts). Target is a continuation of the move, aiming for a high Risk-to-Reward ratio (e.g., 1.5R to 2.6R).
